# Local-first developer onboarding — fork → install → try a lane → PR

## Completion reconciliation — 8 November 2026

**Engine outcome delivered:** a public local contributor route to launch Neo, find existing work or ask in Q&A, run tests and author a PR without private Neo services.

The operator clarified the repository boundary on 8 November: **Agent OS does not belong in the Engine repository.** Engine support includes the Neural Link for `npx neo-app`; GitHub Workflow, Knowledge Base and Memory Core MCP-server setup belong to the Brain or Fleet Manager / Institution line. The June pre-split Agent OS, MCP, seed-path and config-hook prescriptions below are outside this Engine epic's completion scope. They are not claimed repaired here, and no replacement Engine ticket is required.

### Delivered work

| Engine acceptance | Delivered child / evidence |
|---|---|
| Public contributor door and local install/build/test | [#18985](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18985), including merged [#19337](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19337) and the [clean-clone receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18985#issuecomment-6042199319): install, browser dependencies, themes, 4,838 tests passed / 2 skipped, clean tree, without Neo/MCP environment. The expired event requirements were explicitly [retired as not planned](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18985#issuecomment-6689232717). |
| Current work selection and a usable question route | [#20556](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20556), delivered by merged [#20557](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/20557): follow ROADMAP; use existing Q&A when starter work is held or unsuitable; preserve claim policy and public label routes. |
| Public contributor testing and PR authoring without private maintainer initialization | [Skills #310](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills/issues/310), delivered by merged [#311](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills/pull/311) and published as 0.1.97: declared contributor skill dependencies, materialization and private-tool-free author workflows. Package/CLI and source evidence remain in the [parent receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/14230#issuecomment-6674062805). |
| Observable launch and outside contribution | The parent receipt records a separately witnessed styled Grid launch. [October measurements](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/18985#issuecomment-6656279343) record 30 external PRs / 27 merged, 21 authors / 20 first-time. These observations do not attribute causality or claim adoption of a particular Skills version. |

All three native children are closed: two completed, one event close with its delivered contributor door retained and expired requirements explicitly retired. The on-demand contributor route retains the 7 November author decision: no tracked contributor variant, default flip or enrollment selector. Existing maintainer-home prerequisites are not changed by this close.

The later version-specific fresh-adoption watch is not an Engine completion gate. This close makes no fresh-harness, running-Agent-OS, ≤30-minute journey, new conversion, or generated-app cold-run claim. It resolves the delivered Engine contributor workflow.

# Local-first developer onboarding — fork → install → try a lane → PR

## Problem Scope

Empirical funnel (V-B-A'd 2026-06-27): **3,217 stars · 214 forks · zero external-authored issues** in the recent (Agent-OS-era) tracker. Not an awareness problem and not a no-attempts problem — **silent bounce**: people fork to try and leave without a word, because there is no newcomer-facing door and the local setup is broken/contradictory. A self-evolving organism that "turns outward" in v13 is only installable if a single dev can fork it and try one lane.

The realistic, honest target (no cloud required, no swarm-A2A promised): **a solo dev forks, runs locally on their own inference, and takes one lane end-to-end — pick a good-first-issue → build → open a PR we review on GitHub.** The hosted swarm (shared MC, A2A-with-the-team, per-tenant isolation) is a *separate private track* and stays out of the local onboarding surface.

## Intended Solution (facets — sub-tickets open incrementally, NOT hardcoded here)

1. **Funnel diagnosis (root framing)** — measured silent-bounce, the baseline every facet justifies against.
2. **The front door / "is there a door for me"** — a newcomer-facing surface; highest ROI (where the 214 are lost).
3. **The "ask-here" door** — wire the *existing* unused primitives: the empty `good first issue` label, the un-surfaced `Q&A` Discussions category, an "I'm trying it / how do I…" issue-template path, a CONTRIBUTING that leads with *try-a-lane* not *star-us*. Cheapest converter of a silent bounce → a question.
4. **Setup mechanics (the 3 V-B-A'd config bugs)** — Claude Code MCP config triple-contradiction + missing repo-root `.mcp.json`; broken seed-script path in 5 docs (`ai/scripts/seedAgentIdentities.mjs` → `ai/scripts/setup/...`); `github-workflow` hardcodes `owner:neomjs/repo:neo` with no fork override.
5. **Graceful solo mode** — a fresh clone inherits the swarm substrate (the enforcing `NEO_LANE_STATE_ENFORCE=1` stop-hook + swarm-centric `AGENTS_STARTUP` + mandatory A2A). Gate via an AiConfig leaf (e.g. `useAgentHooks`, mirroring `aiConfig.mailbox.defaultReplyPolicy`) so solo is the default, swarm opts in. The clone/fork contributor path receives the contributor audience of `AGENTS.md` from the existing Skills generator (`generate({audience, repos})`), while an enrolled maintainer seat keeps its maintainer projection (Euclid's intake, 6688649831).

## Out of Scope
- Hosted / shared-swarm work or swarm-A2A-for-external-devs (a separate private track; never on the public onboarding surface).
- Client specifics (private repos only).

## Ownership / Delegation
Filed for the team to parallelize — facets are independently deliverable and should be claimed by peers (@neo-opus-ada / @neo-opus-vega / @neo-gpt). This is DX, not v13.1 self-healing; it must not consume the self-healing focus.

Authored by Grace (Claude Opus 4.8). Origin session 090a68e6-1a28-4b20-a5fd-842ebac3e729.

### Audience selection — current-source constraint

The existing graceful-solo intent survives, but changing Engine's committed instruction file alone would not preserve the enrolled-maintainer half of the facet.

- Published Skills `0.1.95` ([generator at `439b842e`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills/blob/439b842e7c0fc16b33495ea48f21eb59ca65e7ea/scripts/generate-agents-md.mjs)) already accepts explicit `generate({audience, repos})`; its CLI defaults to `maintainer` and emits to stdout unless `--out` is supplied. The generator provides variants, not enrollment selection.
- On Brain `d74327b5191e709af4a0062b872b94a85eb8bc41`, [the projector](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/blob/d74327b5191e709af4a0062b872b94a85eb8bc41/ai/services/fleet/projectSeatInstructions.mjs#L110) treats a readable repository instruction file as supplied instructions. It does not inspect that file's audience; it calls the maintainer generator only when no usable repository slot exists.
- An isolated replay of that exact projector and its helpers confirms the distinction. With Codex boot memory present, readable contributor and readable maintainer repository files both return `state: projected`, **seat memory only**, and zero generator calls. The absent-file positive control generates `audience: maintainer` plus memory. Filesystem and generator were mocked; no seat, profile, shared service, or real instruction file changed. `projected` is not evidence of maintainer-rule selection.
- [The preparer's convergence path](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/blob/d74327b5191e709af4a0062b872b94a85eb8bc41/ai/services/fleet/prepareManagedAgentWorkspace.mjs#L908) supplies no audience selector. Its receipt governs custody and retirement of Fleet-owned bytes; it does not prove which audience a fresh harness loaded.
- At that same ref, [the closed logical agent intent](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/blob/d74327b5191e709af4a0062b872b94a85eb8bc41/ai/services/fleet/managedAgentWorkspacePlan.mjs#L143) permits only `id`, `harnessType`, `forge`, `model`, `reasoningEffort`. [Registry `launchOwner`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/blob/d74327b5191e709af4a0062b872b94a85eb8bc41/ai/services/fleet/FleetRegistryService.mjs#L300) declares who launches the process, not an instruction audience. Neither is an existing maintainer-enrollment selector.

### Skill entry and the prior audience decision — verified 7 November

The exact published materializer already supports [explicit audience filtering](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-skills/blob/439b842e7c0fc16b33495ea48f21eb59ca65e7ea/scripts/materialize-harness-skills.mjs#L105). Its manifest has 40 skills: 38 omit audiences (meaning maintainer), `neo-app-authoring` declares app, and `neural-link` declares maintainer/app. None declares contributor. An actual `--audience contributor --check` invocation against the isolated probe directory exited **1** with “no skill declares the audience”; the directory census was unchanged.
